title: Creation, Resurrection, and Worshipping Allah on an Edge

paragraphs.text: Some people argue about Allah without knowledge. They follow every rebellious devil, who leads them to the punishment of the Blaze.

If you doubt the Resurrection, think about how Allah created you. He made you from dust, then a drop of fluid, then a clinging clot, then a lump of flesh. He keeps whom He wills in the womb for a fixed time. Then He brings you out as a baby, and you grow strong. Some die young. Others reach a weak old age and forget all they knew. The earth looks dry and dead. When Allah sends rain, it swells and grows every beautiful plant. This shows that Allah is the Truth and gives life to the dead. The Hour will surely come.

Some people argue about Allah with no knowledge or clear book. They turn away proudly to lead others from His way. They will have shame here and Fire later. Allah is never unjust to His servants. Some people worship Allah on an edge. When good touches them, they are content. When a trial strikes, they turn away and lose both worlds. They call on things that can neither harm nor help.

Allah will admit the believers who do good into gardens with rivers. On the Day of Resurrection, He will judge between all the religious groups. Everything in the heavens and earth bows to Allah. The disbelievers will wear garments of fire, with boiling water poured on their heads.
